ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Refund error"), OR( ISBLANK(Description), ISBLANK(Refund_Request_Date__c), ISBLANK(Amount_Of_Credit_Due__c), OR(ISPICKVAL(Customer_Contacted_Merchant__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Customer_Contacted_Merchant__c, 'NA')), ISBLANK(Merchant_Description__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required: Description of Issue, Refund Request Date, Amount of Credit Due, Customer Contacted Merchant, Merchant Description.
